scheme.scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)
scheme.implementing_agency: Gram Panchayats, Programme Officers, District Programme Coordinators
scheme.description: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), 2005, provides a legal guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work. It is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. Note: As of July 1, 2026, the MGNREGA framework has been succeeded by the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G) Act, 2025, which expands the guarantee to 125 days.
scheme.voice_summary: MGNREGA guaranteed 100 days of paid manual work a year to rural households. It was replaced from 1 July 2026 by the VB-G RAM G Act, which guarantees 125 days.
benefits: Legal guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment per household per financial year (expanded to 125 days under VB-G RAM G Act from July 2026).
Right to unemployment allowance: If work is not provided within 15 days of a formal application, the applicant is entitled to an unemployment allowance from the State Government.
Wages paid directly to the worker's bank or post office account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Work to be provided within 5 km radius of the applicant's residence. If work is beyond 5 km, a travel and subsistence allowance is paid.
Worksite facilities: drinking water, shade for rest, and first-aid must be provided at worksites.
Job Card is issued free of cost.
eligibility: Any adult member (aged 18 years or above) of a rural household.
The applicant must reside in a rural area.
The household must be willing to perform unskilled manual work.
The household must register with their local Gram Panchayat and obtain a Job Card.

scheme.portability: MGNREGA work is typically provided at the Gram Panchayat level where the household is registered. The Job Card is valid within the Block/District of registration. MGNREGA does not have inter-state portability like ONORC. Work demand and entitlements are tied to the registered Gram Panchayat.
exceptions: Urban areas are not covered under MGNREGA. Only rural households are eligible.
Minors (below 18 years) cannot be registered or employed under MGNREGA.
Skilled and semi-skilled work categories are not covered. Only unskilled manual work is guaranteed.
The guarantee is limited to 100 days per household per financial year (125 days under VB-G RAM G from July 2026). Additional days are not guaranteed.
Only unskilled manual work is provided. Skilled or semi-skilled employment is not covered.
The scheme is applicable only in rural areas. Urban residents are not eligible.
Delays in wage payments have been reported in various states, although the Act mandates timely payment.

benefits.text: Legal guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment per household per financial year (expanded to 125 days under VB-G RAM G Act from July 2026).
Right to unemployment allowance: If work is not provided within 15 days of a formal application, the applicant is entitled to an unemployment allowance from the State Government.
Wages paid directly to the worker's bank or post office account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Work to be provided within 5 km radius of the applicant's residence. If work is beyond 5 km, a travel and subsistence allowance is paid.
Worksite facilities: drinking water, shade for rest, and first-aid must be provided at worksites.
Job Card is issued free of cost.
One-third of beneficiaries must be women, promoting women's economic empowerment.
Creation of durable rural assets including water conservation, rural connectivity, land development, and flood control works.

Daily Wage Rate: State-wise wage rates are notified annually by the Ministry of Rural Development. From July 1, 2026, a minimum interim base wage rate of Rs. 300 per day has been introduced under VB-G RAM G, ensuring no state has a wage below this amount.
benefits.source: pib.gov.in, Ministry of Rural Development Gazette Notification

benefits.text: Unemployment Allowance: If employment is not provided within 15 days of application, the State Government must pay an unemployment allowance. The rate is at least one-fourth of the wage rate for the first 30 days and at least one-half thereafter.

Wage Increase (2026-27): Average wage increase across the country is over 10% under the VB-G RAM G Act. States with historically lower wages (UP, Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh) received increases of 15% to 25%.
Travel and Subsistence Allowance: Payable when work is provided beyond 5 km from the applicant's residence.
HISTORICAL: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per household per year (valid until 30 June 2026)
Unemployment allowance payable if employment not provided within 15 days
Ex gratia of Rs 25,000 for death/permanent disability at worksite

Upload the necessary documents (photographs, Aadhaar, proof of residence).

faqs.question: What is MGNREGA?
faqs.answer: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), 2005, is an Indian labour law and social security scheme that guarantees the 'right to work'. It provides at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

faqs.question: How do I get a Job Card?
faqs.answer: Visit your local Gram Panchayat and submit an application (free of cost) with photographs, Aadhaar details, and proof of residence of all adult household members. The Job Card is issued within 15 days after verification.

faqs.question: Is there a fee for registration?
faqs.answer: No. Job Card registration under MGNREGA is completely free. If anyone asks for money for registration, it should be reported to local authorities.

faqs.question: What happens if work is not provided within 15 days?
faqs.answer: If work is not provided within 15 days of a formal written application, the applicant is entitled to an unemployment allowance from the State Government. The rate is at least one-fourth of the wage rate for the first 30 days and at least one-half thereafter.

faqs.question: How are wages paid?
faqs.answer: Wages are paid directly to the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

faqs.question: What is the minimum number of days of work I can demand?
faqs.answer: You can demand a minimum of 14 days of continuous work in your application.

faqs.question: Can women participate in MGNREGA?
faqs.answer: Yes. One-third of the beneficiaries under MGNREGA must be women as per the Act. Women are actively encouraged to participate.

faqs.question: What is VB-G RAM G?
faqs.answer: The Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G) Act, 2025, is the successor legislation to MGNREGA, effective from July 1, 2026. It expands the employment guarantee from 100 to 125 days per household per financial year and introduces a minimum base wage of Rs. 300 per day.

faqs.question: Within how many days must employment be provided under MGNREGA?
faqs.answer: Employment must be provided within 15 days of receiving the application for work. If employment is not provided within 15 days, the applicant is legally entitled to daily unemployment allowance.

catalog_descriptions.en: MGNREGA guaranteed 100 days of paid manual work a year to rural households. It was replaced from 1 July 2026 by the VB-G RAM G Act, which guarantees 125 days.
catalog_descriptions.hi: मनरेगा ने ग्रामीण परिवारों को वर्ष में 100 दिनों के लिए भुगतान किए जाने वाले शारीरिक कार्य की गारंटी दी। इसे 1 जुलाई 2026 से वी. बी.-जी. रैम जी. अधिनियम द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित किया गया था, जो 125 दिनों की गारंटी देता है।
